newsitem.title: USA: Anheuser off on volume, flat market share.
newsitem.headline: Anheuser off on volume, flat market share.

text.p: Anheuser-Busch Cos Inc shares dropped 2-3/8 to 45-1/2 after the beer brewer said its U.S. market share was flat for the first six months of the year.
The company also said its earnings growth for 1997 would be below its long-term goal of double-digit increases.
"Volume growth was below their usual performance," said an analyst who asked not to be identified. "They did not gain market share."
Anheuser said its second-quarter beer volume grew 0.8 percent both domestically and worldwide. Anheuser said its U.S. market share was flat at 44.3 percent for the first half.
Anheuser said it expects earnings growth for 1997 to be consistent with its year-to-date growth.

For the first six months of the year, the company's earnings from continuing operations were up 8.6 percent. That compares with the company's goal of double-digit percentage increases for earnings over the long term.
